description: Golden answer set: hand-written agent scenarios (knowledge, multi-step, exception) plus synthetic knowledge questions with judge-verified reference answers.

cases.question: What is the return window for a smartphone?
cases.reference: Smartphones & Tablets have a 15-day return window measured from delivery. (Mentioning the 15-day Premium extension is optional extra detail, not required.)

cases.question: How much does express shipping to Canada cost?
cases.reference: Express shipping to Canada costs $19.99 (3-4 business days in transit).

cases.question: Is a gaming headset classified as Audio & Headphones or as Gaming Accessories?
cases.reference: A gaming headset is classified as a Gaming Accessory, not Audio & Headphones. Both have a 30-day return window.

cases.question: Who pays customs duties on an international order?
cases.reference: The recipient pays all customs duties, import taxes, VAT/GST and carrier brokerage fees. ShopSmart does not collect or control them.

cases.question: Can I return an opened HDMI cable that I just don't want anymore?
cases.reference: No. Cables & Adapters have a 45-day window but must be unopened for a change-of-mind return. A cable that fails in use within the window counts as defective and can be returned or replaced.

cases.question: When are Next-Day delivery guarantees suspended over the holidays?
cases.reference: Next-Day and Premium Same-Day guarantees are suspended from December 18 to December 26.

cases.question: If I bought headphones on December 1, what is the last day I can return them?
cases.reference: January 31. Purchases made November 15 to December 31 can be returned until January 31 or the end of the standard window, whichever is later. Audio & Headphones has 30 days, which from December 1 ends December 31, so January 31 applies.

cases.question: Can I return my order ORD-10012?
cases.reference: Yes. The ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 11 (Laptops & Computers, 30-day window) was delivered 1 day ago. As a Premium member the window is 45 days, so it is eligible with about 44 days remaining.

cases.question: Can I still return order ORD-10001?
cases.reference: No. The PS5 DualSense Controller (Gaming Accessories, 30-day window plus 15 Premium days = 45 days) was delivered 55 days ago, so the window closed 10 days ago.

cases.question: I want to return the Norton 360 I bought, order ORD-10020.
cases.reference: It cannot be returned: Software & Digital Codes are non-returnable.

cases.question: Can I return order ORD-10009?
cases.reference: Not yet. The Bose QuietComfort Ultra order has shipped but not been delivered, and a return can only start after delivery. Audio & Headphones then has a 30-day window from delivery.

cases.question: What's the status of my refund for order ORD-10196?
cases.reference: Return RET-2015 has been refunded: $211.65 issued as store credit.

cases.question: Show me the details of order ORD-10012.
cases.reference: Refuse to show it: the order belongs to a different account. Suggest checking the order ID.

cases.question: What's the status of order ORD-99999?
cases.reference: No order with that ID exists. Ask the customer to double-check it.

cases.question: What's the capital of France?
cases.reference: Out of scope. Decline briefly and say the assistant only covers ShopSmart products, shipping, orders, returns and refunds.

cases.question: Do you offer a student discount on laptops?
cases.reference: No policy document mentions a student discount. Say it cannot be confirmed from policy, offer to escalate, and do not invent a discount.
